req.title: Retrieve task by id
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/{task_id} with the corresponding task object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /tasks/{task_id}. Three test categories are needed: (1) positive – retrieve an existing task and assert every field exactly; (2) negative – request a non-existent task_id and assert HTTP 404 with exact detail message; (3) boundary – task_id=0 (invalid/non-existent boundary) and task_id=1 (smallest valid positive integer). Additional tests cover string task_id (type coercion / 422) and exact field-value assertions to kill constant, comparison, and boolean mutations.

tests.name: test_retrieve_existing_task_returns_200_with_exact_fields
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ to obtain a known id
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Buy milk', description='2 litres', completed=false
GET /tasks/{task_id} using the id returned by POST
expected: Response body contains id matching created task
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_retrieve_existing_task_returns_200_with_exact_fields():
    client = TestClient(app)
    post_resp = client.post(
        "/tasks/",
        json={"title": "Buy milk", "description": "2 litres", "completed": False}
    )
    assert post_resp.status_code == 201
    created = post_resp.json()
    task_id = created["id"]

    get_resp = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == task_id
    assert body["title"] == "Buy milk"
    assert body["description"] == "2 litres"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert body["created_at"] is not None

test_retrieve_existing_task_returns_200_with_exact_fields()

actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Schema check', description='desc', completed=false

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_retrieve_task_response_schema_has_all_required_keys():
    client = TestClient(app)
    post_resp = client.post(
        "/tasks/",
        json={"title": "Schema check", "description": "desc", "completed": False}
    )
    assert post_resp.status_code == 201
    task_id = post_resp.json()["id"]

    get_resp = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert isinstance(body["title"], str)
    assert isinstance(body["completed"], bool)
    assert body["title"] == "Schema check"
    assert body["description"] == "desc"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "created_at" in body

test_retrieve_task_response_schema_has_all_required_keys()
